notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes: [h1][b]DECEMBER 1st 2025![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Greetings all! We're happy to announce December 1st as the launch date for The Father's Story, as well as it will be launching on Windows, Mac OS, and Linux![/p][p][/p][p]The initial launch will be here on Steam with itch following. iOS and Android versions are still TBA but are planned.[/p]
